landing.hero.title: Don't just find the highest mandi price.
landing.hero.gradientTitle: Find where you take home the most.
landing.hero.subtitle: Two mandis can offer different prices. But the mandi paying the most may not leave the farmer with the most money.
landing.hero.description: Kisan360 compares markets by {strong}net realization{strongEnd} — the headline price minus the costs{em} you{emEnd} bear as a farmer: transport, storage and loading. Then it helps you create a lot, find buyers with transparent trust tiers, send an offer and track the payment — in one place.
landing.hero.demoNote: Sign in as a demo farmer, buyer or FPO. Payments and buyer verification are simulated — clearly labelled in the app.
landing.feature1.title: Compare what you keep
landing.feature1.desc: A higher headline price can mean a lower take-home once transport and storage are counted. We rank by net, not hype.
landing.feature2.title: Every number has a source
landing.feature2.desc: Prices come from AGMARKNET (Govt. of India) with live/cached status and timestamps. The AI only explains results — it never invents figures.
landing.feature3.title: Sell with confidence
landing.feature3.desc: Four-tier buyer trust badges, digital offers, payment-status tracking and FPO bulk pooling — with the simulated parts said out loud.
landing.pillar.title: Built to sit on top of India's existing mandi ecosystem — not replace it.
landing.pillar.desc: Kisan360 is a decision layer over the data sources farmers and FPOs already have: AGMARKNET/eNAM price feeds in, explainable sell decisions out, connected to lots, buyers and offer workflows. It integrates with APMC/eNAM/FPO systems rather than asking anyone to abandon them — and every figure shows its source, timestamp and assumption.
landing.band.text: From the field to the mandi — every price below is an observation with a timestamp, and every cost a documented assumption.
landing.footer: Prototype built for SIH 2026 · Commission/adat is charged to the buyer under the Maharashtra APMC Act s.31 — never deducted from the farmer's net.

trade.deterministicComparison: Deterministic comparison (within {band}% = near reference). Kisan360 informs — you decide.

trade.recordsLearn: Records like these are how the product learns over time — comparing outcomes against assumptions is what would refine future cost estimates. Kisan360 observes, decides, transacts, records; it does not predict.
netRealization.title: Compare What You'll Earn
netRealization.subtitle: What you actually pocket at each mandi — after your transport, storage and loading costs. Deterministic: no AI invents these numbers.
netRealization.ranked: All mandis, ranked by your net

netRealization.decisionDifference: estimated decision difference — not an income guarantee
netRealization.highestHeadlineNotNet: Highest headline price is NOT the highest estimated farmer net.
netRealization.onlyOneMandi: Only one mandi has usable price evidence right now.
netRealization.onlyOneMandiDesc: A comparison — and the best-market recommendation — needs at least two costed mandis. The economics above are correct for this market alone; the ranking data may be limited today (live feed anomaly or cache gap).
netRealization.whatCouldChangeDesc: Change the quantity — every scenario is recomputed server-side by the deterministic engine. Nothing is pre-scripted or estimated in the browser.
netRealization.whatIfSell: What if I sell {qty} q instead of {current}?
netRealization.buyerCoverageDesc: Buyer coverage in the current Kisan360 directory — deterministic matching on crop, service area and minimum quantity. Not a demand estimate.
netRealization.noMatchingBuyer: No current matching buyer in the directory
pathways.title: Your Selling Options
pathways.subtitle: Compare realistic pathways for your lot — sell now, store, aggregate through FPO, or consider an alternative market. Every pathway is computed by the deterministic engine from current evidence.
pathways.insufficientEvidence: Insufficient evidence to cost this pathway right now — shown honestly rather than invented.
pathways.breakeven: Breakeven: sale price must exceed {price}/q to outperform selling now
pathways.thresholdNotPrediction: A threshold, not a prediction — Kisan360 does not forecast future prices.
pathways.evidenceBasedRisk: Evidence-based risk label, not a spoilage prediction.
pathways.qualificationNote: Qualification is a deterministic threshold — not a completed aggregation.
pathways.cropAwareRisk: Crop-aware risk label — evidence-based, not a spoilage prediction.
netRealization.estimatedDecisionDiff: estimated decision difference — not an income guarantee
netRealization.noCompatibleBuyer: No compatible buyer found in the current Kisan360 directory for this lot.
netRealization.stillCreateLot: You can still create the lot, retry buyer discovery later, review the alternative mandis below, or consider FPO aggregation to reach buyer minimums.
netRealization.sensitivityNote: Each row is the same engine re-run with one assumption changed. No prediction — only sensitivity.
netRealization.chasingCosts: Chasing the ₹{gap}/q higher headline at {market} would cost you ₹{netGap}/q ({lotTotal} on this lot) in extra farmer-borne costs. Kisan360 ranks by what you keep — not by the biggest number.
netRealization.explainedBy: AI explanation based on Kisan360 market calculations · explained by: {by} · the AI never generates the numbers.
netRealization.costOfActionable: Estimated cost of taking the immediately actionable path:
netRealization.alsoSee: or review the alternative mandis below
netRealization.ofMandisHaveBuyers: of {total} costed mandis have directory buyers for this lot.
netRealization.atQty: At {qty} q, the best mandi is
netRealization.rankingChanged: The ranking changed with your quantity.
netRealization.netUnchanged: Net per quintal is unchanged — quantity alone does not move per-quintal costs below the bulk threshold.
netRealization.netChanged: Net per quintal changed by {delta}/q versus your current {current} q plan.
netRealization.whyPooledThreshold: Why: pooled volume crosses the 40 q full-truck threshold — transport drops from ₹1.5 to ₹0.75 per quintal-km, so logistics economics change.
netRealization.whyRankingHeld: Why: the ranking held because per-quintal transport only drops at the 40 q full-truck threshold.
